messages:
Jordan: AM async standup — quick pulse on fleet.
Jordan: What I did: drained warm pool in eu-west1 to clear queued prewarm jobs, merged PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 (gpu-balance: reduce warm nodes), bumped batcher to 4.
Jordan: Blockers: GCP quota denial on us-west2-b (preemptible CPUs) causing spot fallback; observed 12% higher evictions last hour. Need quota request or alternate AZ mapping.
Maya: FYI I dug into evictions — grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/evictions/spot-evictions?orgId=1 : looks like APAC spike aligning with model rollout.
Maya: Done: added eviction alert threshold and temporary retry policy for low-priority lanes.
Eli: Today: working on autoscaler tweak to prefer regional spread; draft in #infra-prs, skipping scale-down if headroom < 120 tokens/sec. See snippet:
```
export MIN_HEADROOM=120
./scripts/autoscaler apply --min-headroom $MIN_HEADROOM
```
Anita: Heads-up: planning node drain in eu-west1 at 16:00 UTC for kernel patch. ETA ~30m. Can we avoid draining prewarm lanes?
Jordan: @Anita please add `nodeSelector: no-prewarm` to the drain job, and tag canaries. I'll hold non-critical rollouts.
Sam: opened CLOUD-452 (quota bump request) with cloud ops — assigned to @kris. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CLOUD-452
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: rolling canary to eu-west1 (infra-canary-v5) at 15:12 UTC — status: success :white_check_mark:
Maya: Quick check — Jordan can you run `./tools/fleet-check --region eu-west1 --window 1h` and paste headroom numbers? I want to confirm warm cache impact.
Jordan: Ran and pasted output: headroom eu-west1=140, us-west2=90, apac-east=60. We'll route low-priority to eu-west1 and apac fallback to us-west2. Filing follow-up: TICKET-987 for routing policy change.
Sam: acked :thumbsup: pushing routing change after CLOUD-452 lands.
Jordan: Today: follow-up items — monitor eviction alert, wait for quota reply, hold non-critical canaries until after drain. I'll update the handbook with quick runbook.
Eli: +1, will create PR for routing policy later today.
Anita: Thanks — will shift maintenance window if quota request takes longer.
Jordan: ending notes: if you see spikes, tag `#infra-incident` and ping on-call. Thanks.
